name: frontend-delivery-integration
title: Frontend delivery integration and separation
description: Integrate completed Web UI work, audit the combined frontend, and make the existing web package deployable independently while preserving same-origin authentication.
creator: codex
notes: Fresh code/security review approved and architecture review cleared after all P1/P2 findings were fixed. Product commit b28d6c1d96385c06ddcbf771e713ba2dca62dc83 is published in upstream PR 4 for review. Current admission evidence is 74 frontend tests plus OpenAPI/typecheck/lint/build and 383 passed with 8 environment skips in the non-external-database Python lane. The Web package remains independently buildable inside the monorepo and may deploy separately from the Python API only behind one HTTPS origin. Remaining external gates are isolated PostgreSQL migration/concurrency validation, live Telegram/WeChat acceptance, Redis/MinIO/Celery readiness, real domestic Linux host/DNS/TLS/Nginx/systemd verification, and maintainer-owned migration/deployment authorization. PR 2 remains open and intentionally unmodified; neither PR was automatically merged.
